answer_1.quote: To fully exploit their capabilities, we incorporate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, guiding MLLMs to systematically analyze interactions across visual, auditory, and textual modalities... we propose HVGUARD ... leverages MLLMs to generate multimodal rationales via CoT reasoning, explicitly modeling cross-modal and rhetorical elements.
answer_1.outputs: textual rationales (explanations) generated by the MLLM
